name: pyshield-studio
description: PyShield Studio - Offline Proctored Python Notebook & Security IDE
author: PyShield Team <support@pyshield.dev>

scripts.electron:build:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --linux AppImage && mkdir -p dist-electron/linux && mv dist-electron/*.AppImage dist-electron/linux-unpacked dist-electron/linux/ 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.electron:build:all:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --linux AppImage && mkdir -p dist-electron/linux && mv dist-electron/*.AppImage dist-electron/linux-unpacked dist-electron/linux/ 2>/dev/null || true && bash build-deb.sh
scripts.electron:build:win: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis && mkdir -p dist-electron/windows && mv dist-electron/*.exe dist-electron/*.zip dist-electron/*.nsis.7z dist-electron/win-unpacked dist-electron/windows/ 2>/dev/null || true
